verdict.rationale: Windows has extensive developer documentation on Microsoft Learn, so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for this product. However, the probes found no llms.txt at support.microsoft.com (HTTP 404) and no markdown docs variant (HTTP 404). Nothing else in the pack describes agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
